description: Every Nx project carries exactly one tag from each dimension. `type` and `scope` drive @nx/enforce-module-boundaries in eslint.config.js; `tier` is the Review Tier classifier's primary signal (ADR 0069 item 4). Asserted by tools/scripts/check-nx-project-tags.mjs.

type.app: A deployable application. May depend on anything below it, never on another app.
type.e2e: A Playwright project. Depends only on the app it drives and utilities.
type.page: A route or screen library that composes features. Never imported by another page.
type.feature: A domain feature with its own UI and data access, composed by pages.
type.ui: Presentational components with no data access.
type.data-access: Talks to the API or storage. Never imports UI.
type.domain: Pure domain logic and types with no I/O.
type.util: Leaf helpers, generated specs, tokens. Depends only on other utils.
type.tooling: Repo scripts and checkers. Not application code.

scope.web: The Next.js app and its libraries.
scope.mobile: The React Native app and its libraries.
scope.shared: Imported by more than one scope. May depend only on shared.

tier.human: Failure is silent or unrecoverable: vault, crypto, auth, persistence, gates. A diff reaching this tier is review:human.
tier.agent: Merge on green checks plus an agent verdict with no blocking finding.
tier.auto: Generated or leaf output verified entirely by deterministic checks.
